rag.text:
Test: TC-3493 — Feature area - Risk - Modification of risk values definition
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-83 Feature area - Risk
Labels: tc-tasks-no-dates, teamsource

Steps:
1. Navigate to Big Picture Configuration → Modules tab → Risks tab → Risk value definition section
   Expected: Task sources and Risk value definition section is displayed. 

Risk value definition contain information: "Define labels and values of the Risks matrix. Values must be the same as the mapped Jira custom field's options."

Probability and Consequence settings subsections are visible.
2. Click Add value (plus icon) button, under the Probability subsection
   Expected: New, empty, edit field is visible.
3. Type the valueName in the field, and press Enter
   Data: valueName: High New value
   Expected: valueName is visible on the values list, with green lozenge contains "to be added" text
4. Drag and drop valueName1 to the newPosition
   Data: valueName1: High 
newPosition: 1 (Almost none)
   Expected: valueName1 is moved to the newPosition
5. Click on trash icon of valueName2
   Data: valueName2: Low
   Expected: valueName2 is visible on the values list, with red lozenge contains "to be removed" text
6. Click Add value (plus icon) button, under the Consequence
   Expected: New, empty, edit field is visible.
7. Type the valueName3 in the field, and press Enter
   Data: valueName3: High New value
   Expected: valueName3 is visible on the values list, with green lozenge contains "to be added" text
8. Drag and drop valueName4 to the newPosition
   Data: valueName4: High
newPosition: 3 (Medium)
   Expected: valueName4 is moved to the newPosition
9. Click on trash icon of valueName5
   Data: valueName5: Severe
   Expected: valueName5 is visible on the values list, with red lozenge contains "to be removed" text
10. Scroll down to the Save button
   Expected: Above the Save button is frame with the changes, that will be applied, ordered in the way: 

Probability value to be removed:
Low

Probability value to be added:
High new value

Probability position to be modified:
High position:  1

Consequence value to be removed:
Severe

Consequence value to be added:
High new value

Consequence position to be modified:
High position:  3

Migration toggle button isn't appear.
11. Save changes
   Expected: Save button has a statuses: 

* Save - blue colour;
* Saving - grey clour;
* Saved - green colour.

Changes are saved correctly.
12. Click on probabilityValue and check toggle button
   Data: probabilityValue: Medium
   Expected: "Search for the value..." drop down menu appears
13. Expand drop down menu
   Expected: Drop down menu contains: 

* Search bar
* List of already used and available values: 

High - Already used

Almost Lowest - Already used

Very high - Already used

Low - green check mark

Medium - Already used

The values already used are greyed and not possible choose them.
14. Click Add value (plus icon) button, under the Consequence and type the valueName
   Data: valueName: New value
   Expected: New, empty, edit field is visible.

valueName is visible on the values list, with green lozenge contains "to be added" text.
15. Click Discard changes
   Expected: Changes are abandoned.
16. Click on probabilityValue and type newProbabilityValue
   Data: probabilityValue: Almost None

newProbabilityValue: Lowest
   Expected: Edit mode is active. New value is provided
17. Press Enter
   Expected: Warning red icon appear near New Value.
18. Scroll down to the Save button
   Expected: Above the Save button is frame with the changes, that will be applied, ordered in the way:

* Probability value to be modified:

Almost None -> Lowest

* Toggle button: Migrate existing values to newly selected fields
*  Changes will affect all tasks synchronized with BigPicture. This process can take a while, so we recommend running it during non-business hours.
